[Thinking]
**Creating company introduction**

The user is looking for an introduction of over 200 words for a company. It needs to include professional details like location, history, products, capabilities, quality, certifications, R&D, markets, customer service, and contact information, without including any proprietary details. I want to be careful not to invent false claims, especially regarding certifications unless they’re plausible. Keeping the founding year generic, like "established in [year]," is a good idea. I’ll aim for about 230-300 words in a marketing/business tone.
[/Thinking]

Shijiazhuang Henryte Chemicals Co., LTD., located at No. 166 Yuhua Road (West), Shijiazhuang City, Hebei Province, China, is a professional chemical manufacturer and supplier dedicated to the research, development, production and distribution of specialty and industrial chemicals. Strategically positioned in a major transportation and industrial hub, the company leverages convenient logistics and access to regional supply chains to serve domestic and international customers efficiently.

Henryte Chemicals focuses on delivering high-quality chemical products across a broad range of applications, including specialty intermediates, additives, solvents, and performance chemicals for industries such as coatings, plastics, rubber, pharmaceuticals, agriculture, and water treatment. The company combines modern production facilities with systematic quality control processes to ensure consistent product purity, stability and compliance with customers’ specifications. Emphasis is placed on scalable manufacturing, flexible packaging options and reliable lead times to meet both small-batch R&D needs and large-volume production orders.

Driven by market-oriented R&D, Henryte invests in continuous innovation to adapt formulations, improve process efficiency, and develop environmentally friendlier alternatives where possible. A customer-centric approach guides technical support and after-sales service, with experienced application engineers available to assist with product selection, formulation troubleshooting and regulatory inquiries.

Committed to responsible operations, the company implements safety and environmental management practices across its operations to protect employees, communities and assets. With a focus on building long-term partnerships, Shijiazhuang Henryte Chemicals aims to be a trusted supplier that delivers competitive pricing, consistent quality and responsive service to clients worldwide. For further information or product inquiries, prospective customers are encouraged to contact the company directly at its Shijiazhuang headquarters.
